changelog:
Version 7.8.70

Improvements

  • Smaller fonts: theme fonts that ship only as TTF or OTF files now also get a compressed WOFF copy, which browsers load first (about half the size); the original stays as a fallback and text looks exactly the same.
  • The extra main-image size for high-resolution phones now also fits the latest iPhones.
  • A new optional test setting serves phone-sized copies of large cover images that have no responsive sizes of their own.
